texte.Ein geschützter Raum, in dem du dich ver: A protected space where you feel understood, seen and held — and where you are allowed to be exactly the person you are.
texte.Ich arbeite mit Menschen, die mehr wolle: I work with people who want more.
texte.Mehr Sinn, mehr inneres Gleichgewicht, m: More meaning, more inner balance, more connection with yourself. Not a particular gender, not a particular age, not a particular situation in life — what matters is that you can speak without explaining yourself and without being judged.
texte.Das ist die Rückmeldung, die ich am häuf: That is the feedback I hear most often: that with me you may let go and say what is really going on. Many come back — because they feel they are getting closer to themselves.
texte.Wie das aussieht, wenn wir zusammenarbei: What working together looks like is described below.
texte.Ein Raum, in dem du nicht funktionieren: A space where you do not have to function.
texte.Im Gespräch schauen wir gemeinsam auf da: In conversation we look together at what is really going on inside you. Not at what you tell others when they ask how you are — but at what lies underneath.
texte.Du gewinnst Klarheit über deine Situatio: You gain clarity about your situation, about the patterns that keep repeating, and about your next steps — in your private life as well as at work. I hold a protected space in which you may be honest, including with yourself. I push you towards nothing; you set the pace.
texte.Ein Wochenende heraus aus dem Alltag, in: A weekend away from everyday life, in a small group. No programme to work through, but time, quiet and a setting in which something is allowed to come loose.
texte.Nicht jeder Mensch ist über Worte erreic: Not everyone can be reached through words. For those whose path leads through the body, I also work with

texte.Coaching und hnc ersetzen keine ärztlich: Coaching and hnc are not a substitute for medical or psychotherapeutic treatment and do not provide diagnoses.
You do not need to prepare anything.
texte.Die meisten wissen vor dem ersten Termin: Most people do not really know what to expect before the first appointment. So here is how it works with me.
texte.Am Anfang steht ein kostenloses Erstgesp: It starts with a free first conversation, thirty minutes, by phone or online. You tell me what it is about and we look together at what you need. From there we put together a package — usually several sessions over a period of time, because a single appointment rarely changes much. How many there will be, we decide together.
texte.Wir sehen uns in meinen Räumen in Düssel: We meet in my rooms in Düsseldorf, where you can arrive and settle in peace — or online, if you prefer that or the journey would be too far. What you tell me stays between us. And between appointments I am reachable, in case something comes up that cannot wait until next time.
texte.Welches Paket zu dir passt, entscheiden: Which package suits you we decide together after the first conversation. So that you know beforehand what you are getting into, everything is laid out here.
texte.Nach einer erfolgreichen Karriere in der: After a successful career in business and co-founding several companies with a focus on real estate, I deliberately chose a new path — one that comes from the heart.
texte.Ich wollte meinen beruflichen Lebensinha: I did not want to define my working life by financial success alone. I wanted to contribute something that feels meaningful and worthwhile. For me, that is working with people.
texte.Diese Entscheidung war keine strategisch: That decision was not a strategic one — it came from the heart. Today I accompany people who long for real change, who have a clear goal ahead of them and are ready to walk their path with new clarity, depth and confidence.
texte.Als zertifizierter Life &amp; Business C: As a certified life & business coach I combine solid knowledge with a fine sense for what lies between the lines. In my work I am often described as someone who opens up emotions — someone who makes real feelings visible in a protected space, creates clarity and offers warm support.
texte.Ich arbeite mit Menschen, die mehr wolle: I work with people who want more — more meaning, more inner balance, more connection with themselves. Whether it is about private matters or professional development: my coaching is a space in which you feel understood, seen and held.
texte.Mit Herz, Feingefühl und einem Blick für: With heart, sensitivity and an eye for what matters, I accompany you on your way into your future.
texte.Sitzungen auf Deutsch, Portugiesisch und: Sessions in German, Portuguese and English

texte.Meine Jahre in der Wirtschaft und der Au: My years in business and building several companies with a focus on real estate — that part of my path has not disappeared. For everyone who finally wants to take this side of their life into their own hands, I offer a separate format. I sell nothing and recommend no products. I make sure you understand what you are doing and that you stay with it.

texte.Es ist ein Handwerk. Und Handwerk darf m: It is a craft. And a craft may be learned — at any age, from any starting point.
I know both sides of money.
texte.Vor meiner Arbeit als Coach habe ich Pri: Before my work as a coach I advised private clients at a large German bank. I saw the questions people bring through the door — and how often they leave with the feeling of not having understood something they should have been allowed to understand.
texte.Seit über einem Jahrzehnt baue ich außer: For more than a decade I have also been helping to build several companies with a focus on real estate. So I know not only how to talk about wealth, but how it feels to build some: the doubts at the beginning, the long stretches without visible progress, the decisions you make before you are certain.
texte.Was mich nicht loslässt, ist eine Beobac: One observation will not leave me: many people are clever, work hard and earn well — and still do not know where their money actually goes. Not out of carelessness, but because nobody ever showed them that they are allowed to look.
texte.Es gibt keinen Mindeststand, ab dem man: There is no minimum you have to reach before you may come. Some start with a bank statement they have not looked at for months. Others have had a portfolio for years and finally want to understand it rather than merely own it.
texte.Für alle, bei denen Geld ein diffuses Un: For everyone to whom money is a vague unease. We look at it together: what comes in, what goes out, what stays. We build a buffer that lets you sleep at night and clear up what has piled up. In the end you know your numbers — and that alone changes a surprising amount.
texte.Für alle, die anfangen wollen und nicht: For everyone who wants to begin and does not know where. We go through the basics: how does saving work when it is more than a bank account? What do interest, time and risk really mean? You build a structure that fits your life — and learn enough to decide for yourself instead of having to take someone at their word.
texte.Für alle, die schon etwas aufgebaut habe: For everyone who has already built something. We order what has grown, check whether it still fits your goals, and look at the bigger picture: retirement, children, self-employment, property. Not in order to have more — but to know what it is for.
What I expressly do not do.
texte.Ich bin keine Anlageberaterin und keine: I am not an investment adviser and not a broker. I recommend no products, no funds, no insurance and no individual securities. I sell nothing and receive commission from no one — which is why I can tell you openly when something does not suit you.
texte.Ich mache auch keine Steuerberatung und: Nor do I provide tax advice or legal advice. If that is where your question belongs, I will say so and, if I can, point you to someone.
texte.Ich sorge dafür, dass du verstehst, was: I make sure that you understand what you are doing. That you know your numbers, can judge your options and stay with it, even when it gets tedious. The decisions are yours.
texte.Dreißig Minuten, kostenlos. Du erzählst,: Thirty minutes, free of charge. You tell me where you stand. I tell you which level suits you — and whether I am the right person for you.
texte.Eine ausführliche Sitzung, in der wir al: A thorough session in which we put everything on the table. Afterwards you know where you stand — often for the first time in a long while.
texte.Wir arbeiten in Etappen, mit konkreten S: We work in stages, with concrete steps between appointments. How many there will be depends on what you have in mind.
